div.head: Af 74
div.ab: Gif hie mon inbeslea ⁊ mon bán ofadó, gesylle mon ðæs to bote XV scll'.
Gif hie mon inbeslea ⁊ mon ban ófado, geselle mon ðæs to bote XV scill.
Si quis intro plagietur, ut os extrahatur, sit emenda XV sol.
Gif hie mon inbeslea ⁊ mon ban ófado, geselle mon ðæs to bote XV scill.
If one strikes into it and removes a bone [fragment], let him be paid for that 15 shillings as compensation.
If anyone hacks into it [the shoulder], and a bone is removed, 15 shillings shall be given as compensation for it [in addition to the above].
Wenn jemand in sie hineinhaut und er einen Knochen heraushaut, zahle er zur Busse dessen 15 Schill.
If someone strikes into them and knocks out a bone, let him pay 15 shillings as compensation for it.
